top_10_post_award_oil_comm_nt_pg20.licence_reason: Limited source kitchen area at all prospective levels gives uncertain hydrocarbon fill, and the modest oil volumes identified are insufficient for a standalone development (Wisting 170 km and Goliat 280 km away). New 3D seismic diminished the APA 2019 inventory: Kobbe too deeply buried, Carnian trap
